% PGF decorations.text repeat combined with measured replacement pictures.
\documentclass[border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{tikz}
\usetikzlibrary{decorations.text}

\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}
  \draw[help lines] (0,-.5) grid (8,2.5);
  \draw[gray,dashed] (0,1) -- (8,1);
  \path[decorate,decoration={text effects along path,text={01\ },raise=2pt,
    text effects/.cd,repeat text,
      replace characters=0 with {\fill[purple] circle[radius=2pt];},
      replace characters=1 with {\fill[orange] circle[radius=3pt];}}]
    (0,1) .. controls (2,2.5) and (6,-.5) .. (8,1);
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
